description: Parse, question, and extract structured data from documents available at public URLs.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: PDF Vector API key sent as a Bearer token. Create an account and manage your API key in the dashboard at https://app.pdfvector.com.

actions.name: ask_document
actions.description: Ask a question about a document available at a public URL with PDF Vector.

documentUrl.description: The publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL of the document that PDF Vector should process.

model.description: The PDF Vector model tier. Defaults to auto, which lets PDF Vector select a tier.

documentId.description: An optional external document identifier recorded with PDF Vector usage.

question.description: The question PDF Vector should answer from the document.

inputSchema.description: A public document URL, question, and PDF Vector model options.

markdown.description: The Markdown answer to the question.

pageCount.description: The number of pages processed by PDF Vector.

model.description: The model tier used by PDF Vector.

credits.description: The number of PDF Vector credits consumed by the request.

documentId.description: The external document identifier when one was supplied.

outputSchema.description: The answer and usage metadata returned by PDF Vector.

actions.name: extract_document
actions.description: Extract structured JSON matching a supplied schema from a document at a public URL with PDF Vector.

documentUrl.description: The publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL of the document that PDF Vector should process.

model.description: The PDF Vector model tier. Defaults to auto, which lets PDF Vector select a tier.

documentId.description: An optional external document identifier recorded with PDF Vector usage.

prompt.description: Instructions describing the data to extract from the document.

schema.description: The JSON Schema describing the structure PDF Vector should extract.

inputSchema.description: A public document URL, extraction prompt, JSON Schema, and PDF Vector model options.

data.description: The structured data produced from the caller-supplied JSON Schema.

pageCount.description: The number of pages processed by PDF Vector.

model.description: The model tier used by PDF Vector.

credits.description: The number of PDF Vector credits consumed by the request.

documentId.description: The external document identifier when one was supplied.

outputSchema.description: The extracted JSON value and usage metadata returned by PDF Vector.

actions.name: parse_document
actions.description: Parse a document from a public URL into Markdown with PDF Vector.

documentUrl.description: The publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL of the document that PDF Vector should process.

model.description: The PDF Vector model tier. Defaults to auto, which lets PDF Vector select a tier.

documentId.description: An optional external document identifier recorded with PDF Vector usage.

includePages.description: Whether to include page-separated Markdown in addition to the full document text.

inputSchema.description: A public document URL and PDF Vector parsing options.

markdown.description: The full Markdown content extracted from the document.

pageCount.description: The number of pages processed by PDF Vector.

model.description: The model tier used by PDF Vector.

credits.description: The number of PDF Vector credits consumed by the request.

documentId.description: The external document identifier when one was supplied.

html.description: The rich HTML representation returned when supported by the model.

pageNumber.description: The 1-based page number in the source document.

markdown.description: The Markdown content extracted from this page.

items.description: The extracted content for one document page.

pages.description: Page-separated Markdown when includePages is enabled.

outputSchema.description: The document content and usage metadata returned by PDF Vector.
